title: Labeled medical record number in plain text
rationale: A labeled field names the identifier role, and the value shape alone is not bounded by any source. The labeled value is the evidence. Synthetic value: the SYNTH- prefix marks it as fabricated, it was generated by the authored rule 'SYNTH- plus six digits' and not derived from any record, it sits next to no name, date or clinical detail, and it was not tested against any service. The sources state no MRN format, so no claim is made that real MRNs look or do not look like it; its safety rests on the explicit marker, not on an unissued range.

reasons: Identity here means the label plus a non-empty token establishes the field role; the sources state no value format, so validity of the value itself is not claimed.
The label vocabulary (MRN) is project-authored; the field-label context is research-needed in the taxonomy.
ambiguity.wouldSettle: A provider-documented or standards source listing field labels for medical record numbers.

provenance.inference: Project inference: the label MRN names the identifier role; the documented sources establish the role and the absence of a universal format, not the label.
